column2: In the distant age of myth...
the $$世界$$ was ruled by the hypocrites who believed in such deceptions as $$愛$$,
by the $$大悪神ゴッド$$...
But then, one day,
the great $$大天使$$ Lord $$メフィスト$$, the $$世界$$'s $$救世主$$...
raised his banner against the $$邪神$$ with white $$羽$$, servants of the $$大悪神ゴッド$$...
Under the banner of $$父なる大神サタン$$, he began a holy war for us.
No...
The war that divided Heaven in two lasted six hundred and sixty-six days...
At last, Lord $$メフィスト$$ and his allies imprisoned the foolish $$邪神$$
in the deep subterranean hell beneath the magic city of $$リニア$$...
and delivered us from every hypocrisy in $$この世$$!
Something... is wrong!!
In other words, Lord $$メフィスト$$ is the unquestionable, omniscient and omnipotent $$大天使$$ of this $$世界$$!!
We noble bearers of black $$羽$$ are all direct descendants of that $$救世主$$, Lord $$メフィストフェレス$$...
The color of these $$羽$$ is the clearest proof that we descend from the chosen strong!
Absolutely...
All those who bear lowly white $$羽$$ are descendants of foolish $$邪神$$...
That is why, for us to live in this city of $$リニア$$,
we require $$生けにえ$$ with white $$羽$$ to $$封印$$ these $$邪神$$!!
